Description: Shows your frames per second.
Shows how many times per second you click.
Shows how much RAM the game is using.
Shows your connection delay to the server, in milliseconds.
Shows your X, Y and Z position.
A compass strip showing which way you are facing.
Shows the real-world time.
Shows the address of the server you are playing on.
Shows how many in-game days have passed in this world.
Shows the distance of your last hit on a player or mob.
Counts the hits you land in a row without being hit back.
Shows how fast you are moving, in blocks per second.
Shows your yaw and pitch, plus speed and height if you want.
Shows how long you have been playing this session.
A stopwatch and a countdown timer on your HUD.
Shows the name and icon of the resource pack you are using.
Estimates how fast the server is running (20 TPS means no lag).
Counts the healing potions and soups left in your inventory.
Counts how many of the item in your hand you carry in total.
Shows your armor pieces and held item with their durability.
Lists your active potion effects and the time left on each.
WASD, mouse buttons and space light up on screen as you press them.
Shows the items in your inventory without opening it.
Names the block or mob under your crosshair.
Writes the key of each slot on the hotbar.
Shows your hidden food saturation next to the hunger bar.
Accuracy, damage and health numbers from your fights.
Practice jump resets: shows how many ticks off your jump was after a hit.
Lists the items you pick up and drop, with amounts.
Marks your teammates through walls and lists their distance and health.
Timers for items you just used, like ender pearls and golden apples.
Choose a crosshair style or draw your own pixel by pixel.
Hold a key to zoom in; scroll to zoom further.
Control how sprinting, potions, flying and bows change your field of view.
Turn the camera around your player while you keep walking straight.
Switches to third person only while you hold a key.
Choose the time of day you see. Only changes your screen.
Choose the weather you see. Only changes your screen.
Make fog thinner or remove it, separately for each kind of fog.
Lower or turn off the camera shake when you take damage.
Tints the screen red when your health gets low.
Pick the color players and mobs flash when they get hit.
Draws mobs bigger or smaller.
Change the color and width of the outline on the block you aim at, or fill it.
Draws the edges of the chunk you are standing in.
Change the look of the F3+B hitboxes.
Fullbright, and turning off entity shadows for more FPS.
Shrink or hide the fire, pumpkin, water and other screen overlays.
Change how many particles you see and how they look.
Recolor the enchantment shine on items and armor.
Potions get the full enchanted shine.
Dropped items fall over and lie flat instead of floating and spinning.
Dropped items are drawn as flat icons that always face you.
Change the size and position of held and dropped items.
Makes gold, apples and heads on the ground bigger so they are easy to spot.
Brings back 1.7 animations like block-hitting and the old bow and rod poses.
Change how name tags above players look.
Hide your own name and skin, or other players', on your screen.
Move, resize or hide the sidebar scoreboard.
Change how the player list (Tab) looks.
Stack repeated messages, add timestamps, change the background and keep more history.
Move and resize the big title and subtitle text.
Move and resize the action bar text above the hotbar.
Move, restyle or hide the boss health bar.
Restyle the F3 debug screen.
Use a GUI scale other than the one in Minecraft's options.
Scroll long item tooltips with the mouse wheel.
Leaves a blur trail when you turn the camera.
Blurs the game behind open menus.
Make the game's colors more vivid or more muted.
Shows how long until lit TNT explodes.
Warns you when you get close to the highest block you can place.
Marks the blocks where mobs can spawn in the dark.
Save places and see them in the world with a beam, name and distance.
Press a key to mark the block you look at, and share it in party chat if you want.
Use the sky texture from your resource pack.
A small map of the area around you.
Shows the speed, jump height and health of horses.
Shows your WorldEdit selection in the world.
Stops the inventory moving sideways when you have potion effects.
Lock slots so their items cannot be dropped or moved by accident.
Stops chosen items from being dropped by accident.
Link an inventory slot to a hotbar slot, then shift-click to swap them.
Move the hotbar anywhere and change its shape.
A search box that highlights matching items in containers.
Chests and inventories open with an animation.
Group your resource packs into folders.
Send a saved message or command with one key.
Send a message automatically when chat shows certain text.
Join Hypixel games from a menu.
Auto GG, auto tip and a lobby spam filter for Hypixel.
Extra info on screen for Hypixel Bed Wars.
Look up a player's Hypixel stats with /stats.
Plays a sound when you kill a player.
Set the volume of each sound separately.
After a screenshot: open it, copy it or show it in its folder.
Positional voice chat with Mumble.
Shows the song playing on your computer and lets you control it.
Capes move like real cloth instead of a stiff slab. Press P to turn it on/off.
